facts.text: Commonwealth University of Pennsylvania requires all full-time undergraduate students to live on campus for their first two years.

sources.title: Housing Selection at Lock Haven - Commonwealth University
sources.quote: All full-time undergraduate students must live on-campus for their first two years as part of the residency requirement.
